subject: english
question: Select the sentence that has the correct use of words and spellings from the options given below.

options.text: The profesional athlete pushed her body to the limit, surpassing all expectations and acheiving a new personal record.
The profesional athlete pushed her body to the limit, surpasing all expectasions and achieving a new personal record.
The professional athlete pushed her body to the limit, surpasing all expectations and acheving a new personal record.
The professional athlete pushed her body to the limit, surpassing all expectations and achieving a new personal record.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"professional"** means relating to or connected with a profession. (पेशेवर)

 
 
• **Example:** She is a** professional** musician who performs at concerts worldwide.
 
 
 
• The word **"surpassing"** means exceeding or going beyond. (पार करना)
 
 
• **Example:** His performance was **surpassing** all expectations.
 
 
 
• The word **"achieving"** means successfully reaching a desired objective or result by effort, skill, or courage. (प्राप्त करना)
 
 
• **Example:** She worked hard, **achieving **her goal of becoming a doctor.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** The word "professional" is misspelled as "profesional," and "achieving" is misspelled as "acheiving." (प्रोफेशनल, अचीविंग)

 
 
• **Example:** The profesional athlete pushed her body to the limit, surpassing all expectations and acheiving a new personal record.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** The words "professional," "surpassing," and "expectations" are misspelled as "profesional," "surpasing," and "expectasions," respectively. (प्रोफेशनल, सरपासिंग, एक्सपेक्टेशन्स)
 
 
• **Example:** The profesional athlete pushed her body to the limit, surpasing all expectasions and achieving a new personal record.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** The words "surpassing" and "achieving" are misspelled as "surpasing" and "acheving," respectively. (सरपासिंग, अचीविंग)
 
 
• **Example:** The professional athlete pushed her body to the limit, surpasing all expectations and acheving a new personal record.
